secrets.name: MASTER_KEY
secrets.description: Encryption key for the connector vault (openssl rand -base64 32). Required at boot — a dev placeholder is generated automatically.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key for the Claude AI agents. Without it the app boots but agent tasks fail. Get it from https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys.

secrets.name: SPAPI_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Amazon SP-API client ID (Seller Central → Settings → Authorization). Optional.

secrets.name: SPAPI_REFRESH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Amazon SP-API refresh token (paste in admin panel or set here). Optional.

secrets.name: SPAPI_SELLER_ID
secrets.description: Amazon Seller Central merchant token (for listing/price writes). Optional.

secrets.name: ADS_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Amazon Ads API client ID. Optional.

secrets.name: ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Amazon Ads API client secret. Optional.

secrets.name: ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Amazon Ads API refresh token. Optional.

secrets.name: ADS_PROFILE_ID
secrets.description: Amazon Ads API profile ID. Optional.
